newsitem.title: CHINA: China passes moves to control nuclear exports.
newsitem.headline: China passes moves to control nuclear exports.

text.p: China, suspected of exporting nuclear technology to unsafeguarded nuclear facilities abroad, has passed a regulation to control nuclear exports but shed little light on its contents.

Premier Li Peng chaired a meeting of the executive committee of the State Council, or cabinet, which ended on Friday after passing a draft regulation on the control of nuclear exports, the Xinhua news agency said.
The regulation consists of 22 clauses and an accompanying annex listing nuclear exports subject to control, Xinhua said without giving further details.

"Committee members stressed the necessity for formulating the nuclear export control regulation to safeguard national security and public interests, as well as promote international cooperation in the peaceful use of nuclear energy," it said.
The United States suspects China has exported nuclear technology to unsafeguarded facilities abroad, most notably Pakistan. Both China and Pakistan have denied such allegations.
China agreed in May last year not to provide nuclear technology to unsafeguarded facilities.
